subject: Re: Kickoff: Project Basalt — unified dataset interface
body:
Dmitri — Basalt resourcing.

Staffing: Csilla 50% (taxonomy and feature audit), Rosa 50% (loaders and TFDS packaging), Quentin 30% (MSeg universal mapping QA), Umar 30% (Corpus integration).

Compute is negligible — this is an ingestion project — but storage isn't: mirroring the 19 redistributable datasets runs about 9TB raw plus 4TB in TFDS-prepared form, so I've filed a 15TB Corpus quota request with Jun's team.

Dependencies: Corpus integration has to land while the v2 APIs are still moving toward the 2026-07-10 migration freeze. We're well ahead of it, but Umar's prototype should target the v2 write path directly rather than v1 to avoid a rewrite.

Ask from you: a prioritized list of which datasets the first Corpus customers actually need, so Rosa doesn't burn March packaging long-tail sets.

Bruno
